Name: Just a Fishing Bar Fish Replacer
Author: nolioblivisci
Description:
[center][size=5]DESCRIPTION
[/size][/center]Ever thought that the fish on the fishing bar looks traumatized? Like it's been through two wars and then some? Well, now you can change it for one of the sprites of the vanilla fish or some non-fish objects, around 30 variants. I tried to add a few choices for each of the primary colors.

IMPORTANT!! 

It does NOT change the sprite to the fish you're currently catching. For that you can check out [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8970?tab=description]Fishing Info Overlays[/url]﻿.


[center][size=5]INSTALLATION
[/size][/center]Unzip the archive into the Mods folder. Requires SMAPI and Content Patcher to work.


[center][size=5]MODS FROM SCREENSHOTS
[/size][/center][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35996]DBB's Victorian Gothic UI [/url]for the Interface recolor
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolor[/url] with some [url=https://reshade.me]ReShade[/url] adjustments for the main recolor
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4966]Foliage Redone[/url] for the trees
